Checking whether your turns since 03:22 were even recorded.Gist: You're right: the stepper was stuck at 02:57, 80 minutes behind. I've caught it up by hand to frame 127, your 03:22 turn. Nothing of yours from after that has been read yet, but the pool is now reading promptly. Your 04:14 turn went to 象-1 and started 16 seconds later, where the old seat was making turns wait 8 to 11 minutes. The stepper should now update by itself as each reading lands.

**Why it stopped:**
- **Readings landed after the reaper gave up.** Your turns from 03:06 to 03:22 were all read eventually, but after the old reaper's 9-minute cutoff, so their landing never triggered the reload. I fixed that at 04:01.
- **One thing I can't explain:** the one-off replay I ran then, for readings that had already landed, should also have reloaded the stepper, but the trace shows no reload after 03:06. Triggering the same reload by hand just now worked: frame 127, logged in the trace at 04:19. So the reload code is fine, but why that earlier call didn't take is still open.

**What's still waiting:**
- **Your 04:13 turn:** it was sent just before the pool went live, so it's still queued behind the old 象 seat's backlog. It will be read, just late.
- **Your 04:14 turn:** being read by 象-1 now.
- **This turn and later:** these go to the pool.
